entities.name: UE-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure that provides transport of various message types and containers from UE to AMF, optionally with associated payload routing information.

entities.name: Payload container IE
entities.description: Information element that contains payload container entries for multiple transport types, each with payload and optional routing information.

entities.name: 5GSM message
entities.description: Single 5GSM message as defined in subclause 8.3 that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: SMS
entities.description: Short Message Service payload that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: LPP message
entities.description: LPP (LTE Positioning Protocol) message that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: SOR transparent container
entities.description: Steering of Roaming transparent container that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: UE policy container
entities.description: UE policy container that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: UE parameters update transparent container
entities.description: UE parameters update transparent container that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: Location services message
entities.description: Location services message that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: CIoT user data container
entities.description: CIoT user data container that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: Service-level-AA container that can be transported via NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: Payload routing information
entities.description: Optional associated payload routing information that can be included with payload containers for routing purposes.

relations.description: The UE-initiated NAS transport procedure uses the Payload container IE to transport various payload types.
Payload container can contain 5GSM message payload.
Payload container can contain SMS payload.
Payload container can contain LPP message payload.
Payload container can contain SOR transparent container payload.
Payload container can contain UE policy container payload.
Payload container can contain UE parameters update transparent container payload.
Payload container can contain location services message payload.
Payload container can contain CIoT user data container payload.
Payload container can contain Service-level-AA container payload.
Payload container can contain optional payload routing information for routing purposes.
